title: UniWorld: A Unified World Model for Real-Time Visual World Simulation
title_zh: UniWorld：面向实时视觉世界模拟的统一世界模型
abstract: Continuous visual world simulation requires coupling evolving scene geometry with temporally persistent appearance. We present UniWorld, a unified framework that integrates depth trajectories and reference appearance within a shared video generation model. The central design maintains visual and geometric histories on a common timeline. Noise-aligned overlapping continuation places generated history at the prescribed sampling noise level and commits only newly generated latents. Rolling depth latent state preserves the corresponding geometric controls, incrementally reads newly available geometry, and keeps the conditioning fixed within each sampling window. Together, these mechanisms ensure exact preservation of latent history while bounding the active depth state by the window size. We evaluate continuous generation, paired history interventions, and long-horizon behavior across diverse scene categories. The same generator supports estimated, native, and on-demand simulator depth, while cached and incremental execution paths produce bitwise-identical outputs. Appearance changes and geometric control branches operate through the same interface without modifying committed history. The measured steady-state DiT execution path achieves real-time generation throughput, demonstrating the efficiency of UniWorld for continuous visual world simulation. Project page: https://zephipage.github.io/UniWorld.
abstract_zh: 连续视觉世界模拟需要将不断演化的场景几何与时间上持久的外观相耦合。我们提出 UniWorld，一个在共享视频生成模型中集成深度轨迹与参考外观的统一框架。核心设计在共同时间线上维护视觉与几何历史。噪声对齐的重叠延续将生成的历史置于规定的采样噪声水平，并仅提交新生成的潜在变量。滚动深度潜在状态保留相应的几何控制，增量读取新可用的几何信息，并在每个采样窗口内保持条件固定。这些机制共同确保潜在历史的精确保留，同时通过窗口大小限制活跃深度状态。我们在多样场景类别上评估连续生成、配对历史干预和长时程行为。同一生成器支持估计的、原生的和按需的模拟器深度，而缓存和增量执行路径产生逐位相同的输出。外观变化和几何控制分支通过相同接口操作，而不修改已提交的历史。测得的稳态 DiT 执行路径实现实时生成吞吐量，展示了 UniWorld 在连续视觉世界模拟中的效率。项目页面：https://zephipage.github.io/UniWorld。
tldr_zh: UniWorld 统一视频生成模型，实现实时连续视觉世界模拟。
cover_zh: 实时模拟视觉世界｜UniWorld 让生成模型记住历史
